name: Emberwell
desc: A longsword that is entirely gemstone, said to be crafted for the path of righteousness. When unsheathed, it glows with the luster of blue flame.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Rise of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
In the east of the tundra, that arrogant monster born within the wing-like mountain is nothing more than a lowly peddler of malt and minerals.
The Vila under his command are but weaklings with insect wings, while the Domovoy cannot even lift weapons with their stunted arms.
Who would heed the clamor of such rabble? What strength could they possibly have to stand against the onslaught of the kings of Volkodlak?

materials.name: Accreted Fragment
materials.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has only just begun to attach to an internal organ or bone. As the Volkodlak's power grows, it may eventually cover an entire region of the body, or a whole organ.

materials.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Muster of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"They seized the canyon by sheer luck. That laughably arrogant fool is no more than a spent bolt, a fading gale."
"Even with all their strength, they can barely hold back a fraction of our forces. Soon enough, their defeat will be plain to see."
"Soldiers, march onward! For our king has already foretold, for this entire campaign shall end in effortless victory!"

materials.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has clung to an internal organ or bone for a long time. Once removed, such accretions are regarded as symbols of power and carefully preserved by the creature's descendants.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystal
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Clarion of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"Our enemy Monomakh has built his palace beyond the valley, a sign that he is fully confident in his ability to contend with us."
"As matters stand, he deserves our utmost caution. Any talk of a swift victory should now be set aside."
"But it matters not. With wisdom to guide us all, the King shall stand with the clans to overcome every hardship and usher in a glorious new era!"

materials.name: Accreted Growth
materials.desc:
An accretion formed by powerful Volkodlak.
An accretion that has fully fused with an organ or bone. One could even say it's a newly grown bone or organ at the nodes of the Volkodlak's power circulation. Only long-lived Volkodlaks who have ceaselessly honed their strength can form such growths within their bodies.

materials.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
materials.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Triumph of the Pale Star Army
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
"All hail the Tsar, Protector of all fae, Heir to the Pale Star, sovereign born of sacred blood!"
"Praise be, for the entire tundra now stands as one beneath the brilliance of the Polestar!"
"Praise be, for His Majesty has slain the false king and embraced all fae. Such is his benevolence, such is his mercy!"

materials.desc:

customize.name: Borderland Sword Billet
customize.desc:
Weapon forging material. Can be used to forge 4-star swords.

In terms of the "state" of the many weapons that can be crafted from billets, while their potential has long been contained within the original materials, the exact forms these weapons will ultimately take remain unknown to this day...

customize.name: Rainbowdrop Crystal
customize.desc:
A crystal that gives off an iridescent glow. Exceptionally tough and malleable, it has been regarded by Snezhnayan craftspeople as the best forging material since ancient times.
It is believed that when the moon's chariot was shattered, its blood-stained axle-tip fell into the earthly realm beneath the moon, transforming into an iridescent crystal. From that day on, the people of this land no longer worshipped the dead gods. The survivors who knew what the monarchs of the night died for, however, still futilely sing those long-forgotten names.

customize.name: White Iron Chunk
customize.desc: Skilled hands can make this into something brilliant.

customize.name: Diagram: Emberwell
customize.desc: A blueprint recreated by Kuzmichev based on records of old legends. Learn it and you can restore Emberwell (Sword).

customize.name: Blade of Atonement
customize.desc: A greatsword passed down by the Luchkin. It is said that only the bravest warrior is qualified to wield it.

customize.name: Song of the Vigil
customize.desc: A long spear that once stood guard over all. Today, it has found a new purpose with children and their games of make-believe.

customize.name: Echoes of the Heart
customize.desc: A Catalyst said to crystallize voice. Within it lies a sealed oath of loyalty, as well as a heart long since forgotten by mankind.

customize.name: Covenant of Frost and Snow
customize.desc: A longbow crafted to preserve order. Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.

desc.text:
"Many long years ago, a member of fae royalty was worshipped in the shadows,"
"Until a cleansing hand came forth and slew them, leaving behind an ancient family name and forgotten remains."
Many such glorious epics are destined to be forgotten by time, the vanquished in the great game of survival.
The defeated young man laughed playfully, and swapped the honorifics and titles this way and that in his cryptic verse:
"O Pearl of the land of ashes, eminent lords and ladies of noble name, and esteemed worthies,"
"No grudge there is between you and I. This is a mere contest of strength, a dispute that breaks no boundaries."
"Though the outcome has been decided, I deem it best that we shake hands and make peace. Let us together cleanse this long road of filth and dust."
"Thus shall we earn the praise of the people who dwell amidst ashes, and those falsely beneficent lords shall hear of our deed and quail."
The young woman, lovely as a pearl, spoke forth with prideful face and menacing voice:
"Listen ye, soot-worms of Kitezhgrad, humans whose sole trade is thievery."
"Remember this your loss, and depart according to your wager, before this lady's patience runs dry."
"Remember also this name, for it shall reclaim all that has been lost,"
"A day shall come when no one shall address the princess's descendants by their sacred name."
The young man paid the loss no heed, and indeed still saw fighting against injustice as a game. He grew ever more revered, and he lit the way towards equity.
The young woman, however, was nourished by brutality. She took for her title "Burner of Cities," and they propped her up as a ruler of destruction and emptiness.
At their next confrontation, what was once a petty squabble was now a battle for the safety of the citizenry,
And the tables were turned. Facing a rival with whom he shared mutual respect, the guiding one's compassion grew within him,
And where once he might have drawn upon old cunning or donned an irreverent look, he sought then to earnestly persuade:
"Your noble name has been woven by those with ulterior motives into a hollow banner, and they have led you to lose all."
"But people even now shall forgive you, in the name of the ashes, of Kitezhgrad, and indeed, of Snezhnaya."
But though she was beaten by one she had once vanquished, the young woman, yet beautiful as pearls, wore an arrogant look, her head yet held high.
"The Burner of Cities and her followers shall not submit to Snezhnaya, nor shall the land of ashes be the abode of those of royal descent."
"Base purveyors of false beneficence, opportunists of history... You are not fit to speak of conciliation and absolution."
A premediated third encounter became their final reunion.
The beating heart of destruction had turned into gunpowder, yearning to glimpse the end of all living beings via the train speeding toward the blast furnace.
The Burner of Cities and her followers plotted to destroy the Kresnik's Torches, to have Snezhnaya play pallbearer to her ancient family name.
The guide, sharp as blade, the ancestor who founded the Luchkin, led the people once more in thwarting the devices of those thugs.
As to that final contest, it has been interpreted countless different ways in the tales passed from generation to generation,
But only because the guide's followers continued to relive and recite the past over the centuries.
"Alas for his mercy, that instead aroused her rage. Alas for his benevolence, that failed to inspire repentence in those brigands."
"The battle at a stalemate, the two leapt upon the furnace, and together fell into the flames, and they perished, the good and the wicked both."
The gloom that had blanketed the tundra dissipated amidst the new dawn caused by that fall.
As to who had won or lost their previous encounters, the sharp blade and bright pearl of the land of ashes would tell not, for they now slumbered.
Darkness now covered their eyes. Fortunately, the prized sword that fell to the earth was rescued from the thin snow.
"O sword that keeps vigil over the people, let the path you guided us upon also be law that those who come after shall follow."
